about: Sherbrooke is the principal city of the Eastern Townships (Estrie), at the confluence of the Saint-François and Magog rivers in southern Québec. It is a bilingual regional centre with several universities and a downtown in a river valley. Surrounding hills and lakes make it a service hub for a large rural hinterland. About 170,000 people live in Sherbrooke.
